messages:
sophie: Heads-up — seeing a weird spike in request queueing on eu-west-1 dedicated pool around 11:38 UTC. 5xxs are low but p95/p99 latency jumps and router is spilling traffic to shared pools. Not sure if this is a tenant probe or real burst. :thinking:
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-542 and assigned to @arjun (oncall).
arjun: grabbing logs now. Can someone paste the router decision metrics? I'm checking route-controller and soft-quota evictions.
lina: quick note — I noticed a pattern where many small-QPS chat tenants with long seq_len (>>1024) cause KV cache churn. That + continuous batching leads to large batches with one slow token holder -> HOL blocking.
marc: add this metric to triage: pool_inflight_per_tenant and pool_qps_by_tenant. Also check GPU-side preemption flags; nvidia-smi dmon showed periodic 100% mem utilization on hosts A/B.
sophie: pastes excerpt from router logs:
```
[2026-02-18T11:38:12Z] route=eu-west-1-dedicated tenant=acme-chat action=evict reason=batch_timeout fallback_target=shared-gpu status=429
[2026-02-18T11:38:13Z] route=eu-west-1-dedicated tenant=acme-chat action=forward fallback_target=shared-gpu status=200 latency_ms=740
```
arjun: that looks like an immediate fallback on a single sample. We should differentiate transient headroom blips from sustained saturation. Can we query: summarize(router.fallbacks.eu-west-1, '1m', 'sum')?
deploybot: Canary tweak deployed to eu-west-1 at 12:05 UTC: fallback_threshold bumped 0.85 -> 0.9 (canary=10% of requests).
jamie: TL;DR: routing is too aggressive on single-sample spikes. Suggest debounce: require sustained overload >30s before triggering fallback, and emit a probe event when fallback happens so we can correlate tenant-level signals. :+1:
lina: also propose a short-term mitigation: per-tenant dynamic batch cap when seq_len>1024 -> cap batch_size=4 and prefer prefix caching for repeated sessions. That should reduce HOL effects.
marc: cost note: fallback to shared increases unit token cost ~1.8x for affected requests. I'll run a billing delta for the last 24h to estimate hit and flag expensive tenants.
sophie: Proposed immediate action items:
 - add 30s debounce in router before marking pool saturated
 - emit structured probe events when fallback happens (tenant, reason, pool state)
 - add grafana panel for shared_pool_fallback_rate by tenant
 - run quick billing drill for Feb surge impact
Who volunteers to own the debounce+probe change?
arjun: I'll own debounce + probe events, will push small canary tonight. tagging @jamie for rollout and alert threshold changes.
jamie: ack. I'll update rollout policy to require a 2-step canary for routing config and bump alert thresholds to avoid noise. I'll also add a grafana panel for shared_pool_fallback_rate and per-tenant token-cost impact.
ops-bot: Note: this thread is linked to INC-2026-542 and PR#8342.
sophie: thanks all. I'll monitor eu-west-1 for the next 6h and post a follow-up. If the canary shows improvement we can backfill a postmortem with root cause (KV churn + HOL batching). :eyes:
